name: Garberlalm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Garberlalm in Hinterriß!**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, the **Garberlalm** is a cozy alpine hut offering breathtaking views of the **Karwendel** mountain range. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this idyllic retreat is perfect for nature lovers, hikers, and families.

Enjoy traditional **Tiroler** hospitality with hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Käse** (cheese), and homemade **Apfelstrudel**. The rustic atmosphere and warm service make every visit unforgettable.

Whether you're seeking adventure on the surrounding trails or simply relaxing with a cup of **Kaffee** and a slice of **Sachertorte**, the **Garberlalm** promises an authentic alpine experience.

**Come and discover the magic of the mountains!**
